code: library(ComPoM) library(dplyr) library(tidyr) library(sdmTMB) library(ggplot2)  set.seed(1) bins  <- seq(20, 80, by = 10) sel   <- function(L, L50) 1 / (1 + exp(-(L - L50) / 5)) avail <- exp(-0.04 * (bins - 20))  locs <- tibble(loc = 1:60, x = runif(60, 0, 100), y = runif(60, 0, 100))  comp <- expand_grid(loc = 1:60, Year = 1:6, Season = 1:2) |>   left_join(locs, by = "loc") |>   slice_sample(prop = 0.4, weight_by = exp(-x / 25) * ifelse(Season == 1, 2, 1)) |>   rowwise() |>   mutate(     L50   = 40 + 2 * (Year - 3) + 4 * (Season == 2) + 0.15 * (x - 50),     p     = list(sel(bins, L50) * avail / sum(sel(bins, L50) * avail)),     count = list(as.vector(rmultinom(1, 40, p)))   ) |>   ungroup() |>   mutate(bin = list(bins), Year = factor(Year), Season = factor(Season)) |>   select(loc, Year, Season, x, y, bin, count) |>   unnest(c(bin, count))

code: # Sample locations with strong spatial bias (prefer high x AND high y corner) sample_locations <- function(n_samps, locations) {   # Strong bias towards the northeast corner of the domain   probs <- exp(locations$x / 25 + locations$y / 25)   probs <- probs / sum(probs)   sample(locations$loc_id, n_samps, replace = TRUE, prob = probs) }  # Season sampling probabilities that shift across years # Early years oversample season 1, late years oversample season 4 season_probs_by_year <- function(year, n_years, n_seasons) {   # Linear shift: weight moves from season 1 to season 4 over time   alpha <- (year - 1) / (n_years - 1)  # 0 for year 1, 1 for last year   weights <- numeric(n_seasons)   weights[1] <- 4 * (1 - alpha) + 0.5 * alpha    weights[n_seasons] <- 0.5 * (1 - alpha) + 4 * alpha   # Middle seasons stay low   if (n_seasons > 2) {     weights[2:(n_seasons - 1)] <- 0.5   }   weights / sum(weights) }  # Generate samples - distribute across years set.seed(456) samples <- tibble(   samp_id = 1:(n_samps * n_years),   Year = factor(rep(1:n_years, each = n_samps)) ) |>   mutate(     loc_id = sample_locations(n(), locations),     Season = factor(sapply(as.integer(Year), function(yr) {       sample(1:n_seasons, 1, prob = season_probs_by_year(yr, n_years, n_seasons))     }))   ) |>   left_join(locations, by = "loc_id") |>   left_join(temporal_df, by = c("Year", "Season")) |>   mutate(     L50 = exp(log(L50_base) + spatial_effect + year_effect + season_effect)   )  # Generate composition samples from each sampling event long_form_sims <- samples |>   group_by(samp_id) |>   nest() |>   mutate(     comp_samps = lapply(data, function(df) {       which(rmultinom(n_per_samps, 1,                       Selectivity(1:n_bins, df$L50, L95) * popfreq) == 1,             arr.ind = TRUE)[, 1]     })   ) |>   unnest(c(data, comp_samps)) |>   mutate(count = 1) |>   rename(bin = comp_samps)  # Visualize sampling locations ggplot() +   geom_point(data = locations, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = "Candidate"), size = 2) +   geom_point(data = long_form_sims |> distinct(loc_id, x, y),              aes(x = x, y = y, colour = "Sampled"), alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +   scale_colour_manual(values = c(Candidate = "grey70", Sampled = "orange"), name = NULL) +   coord_equal() +   theme(legend.position = "bottom")
